newsitem.title: UK: Saudi Arabia raises Jan crude prices to U.S..
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia raises Jan crude prices to U.S..

text.p: Saudi Arabia's Aramco raised crude oil prices for U.S. lifters by 15-20 cents for January while keeping prices for European customers unchanged, traders said.
It also raised the price of its Berri Extra Light crude to Far Eastern customers by 15 cents. It kept other grades unchanged.2
The price rise to U.S. lifters took Berri Extra Light up to WTI -$1.90 a barrel, Arab Light to WTI -$2.80, Arab Medium to WTI -$3.65 and Arab Heavy to WTI -$4.25.
Berri Extra Light to Asian customers rose to Oman/Dubai +$2.00.
